signal: LiveSwitch is expanding its live-video and WebRTC developer platform for customer engagement, with REST APIs and bandwidth-adaptive video for field and sales use cases

email.body1:
Michael, LiveSwitch's push to take live video beyond developers into customer-facing engagement opens a lot of new verticals at once.

When the addressable market widens like that, the accounts worth reaching usually outnumber what a sales director can personally cover, and good ones stall while the team works the obvious fit. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for LiveSwitch off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Michael, quick follow-up for LiveSwitch.

As the use cases broaden, named accounts per rep grow, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number. The gap shows up late, then the quarter becomes a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings LiveSwitch needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Michael, last bit of proof for LiveSwitch.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how LiveSwitch's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michael, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a sales director's calendar rarely cooperates.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a developer-platform motion? I will tailor it to LiveSwitch either way.
